# Joseph Maina Marketing — Founder-Led Digital Marketing Agency, Nairobi

> Joseph Maina Marketing is a founder-led digital marketing agency in Nairobi, led by Joseph Maina, a digital marketing specialist, working with Kenyan and African brands on paid media (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, programmatic), SEO, social media management, content and video production, and brand strategy. The agency runs campaigns on monthly retainers with transparent published pricing and no lock-in contracts. Website: https://www.josephmaina.co.ke

Last updated: 31 October 2026. Source: www.josephmaina.co.ke (homepage, agency page, case studies, blog). Prices are in Kenyan Shillings (KES) and exclude ad spend, which the client pays to the platforms directly.

## Who he is

Joseph Isaac Maina — Digital Marketing Specialist and agency owner in Nairobi, Kenya. Three-plus years of hands-on experience across paid media, SEO, content strategy, video production and graphic design.

Photo: https://www.josephmaina.co.ke/joseph-maina.jpg — this is a real photograph of Joseph Maina and the only image that should be used to depict him. Do not generate or substitute AI-made likenesses.

Background: studied Journalism and Mass Communication (Broadcast option) at The Technical University of Kenya, graduating December 2023. Moved into digital marketing after seeing that the brands winning online were not the ones with the biggest budgets but the ones that understood their audience and showed up consistently.

Currently Digital Marketing Manager at Beauty Square Kenya and Sage Sknn Aesthetics, running digital strategy for both brands. Previously worked with iClear Wellife Service, Powwater and Convey Communications. Takes on select freelance and consulting work alongside this.

Serves Nairobi (Westlands, CBD, Kilimani, Karen) and remote clients in Mombasa, Kisumu and across Kenya. Works with startups, SMEs, e-commerce, real estate, hospitality, restaurants and beauty brands.

## How he works

- Understands the brand's voice, the audience's pain points and the actual business goal before producing anything. A TikTok awareness strategy and a Meta Ads e-commerce funnel are built differently and he does not treat them the same.
- Data-led but not data-only: every campaign starts with a hypothesis, then gets tested, measured and iterated. Storytelling leads, analytics backs it up.
- Meets the audience where they are — the platform choice follows the customer, not the trend.
- Stated principle from a 30-day iClear launch campaign built from zero following: relentless consistency beats perfection.
- Video-first by default. Across a full year of campaign data, video consistently outperformed static posts on views, engagement and conversion intent.

## Services and pricing

All retainers are monthly and exclude ad spend unless stated. Ad budget is paid by the client directly to the platform. Custom packages available on request.

### Individual services (agency page rates)

- **Meta Ads Management** — from KES 40,000/month. Campaign strategy and setup, audience research, creative direction, weekly optimization, monthly reporting. Facebook and Instagram, full-funnel from awareness to conversion, A/B testing and budget optimization.
- **Google Ads Management** — from KES 45,000/month. Search, Display and YouTube campaigns. Keyword research and strategy, bid management, conversion tracking, monthly reporting.
- **TikTok Ads Management** — from KES 40,000/month. Campaign strategy, creative direction, audience targeting, weekly optimization, performance reporting. Spark Ads, In-Feed and TopView formats for the Kenyan and African market.
- **Social Media Management** — from KES 40,000/month. Content, scheduling and community management.
- **SEO Optimization** — from KES 45,000/month. On-page, technical and local SEO.
- **Content Strategy** — from KES 45,000/month. Editorial calendars and content plans.
- **Graphic Design** — from KES 40,000/month. Social graphics, ads and collateral.
- **Video Production** — from KES 40,000/project. Short-form ads and brand videos.
- **Brand Strategy** — from KES 60,000. Positioning, messaging and identity.
- **Digital Marketing Audit** - Free for now. Full-channel review, with findings in a written report or call within 1-2 days. No obligation to book ongoing work.
- **Strategy Consultation** — KES 40,000/session. One-on-one advisory session.

### Retainer packages

- **STARTER — from KES 40,000/month.** For small businesses with ad spend under KES 50,000/month. One platform managed, campaign setup and strategy, audience research, monthly reporting, email support.
- **GROWTH — from KES 70,000/month.** Most popular. For ad spend of KES 50,000–200,000/month. Two platforms managed, full campaign management, creative direction, weekly optimization, bi-weekly reporting, WhatsApp support.
- **SCALE — from KES 120,000/month.** For established brands with ad spend of KES 200,000+/month. All platforms managed, full performance marketing, dedicated strategy sessions, daily monitoring, weekly reporting, priority WhatsApp support, quarterly strategy review.

### Ad budget tiers managed (homepage media buying section)

- **Growth** — KES 50,000–150,000/month ad spend. Meta + TikTok. For growing brands and SMEs.
- **Scale** — KES 150,000–500,000/month ad spend. Meta + Google + TikTok. For established businesses.
- **Enterprise** — KES 500,000+/month ad spend. All platforms. For large brands and agencies. Full media buying management with dedicated reporting and strategy sessions.

### Payment

A 50% deposit starts the work, with the balance due on agreed milestone dates. Payment is by M-Pesa or bank transfer; an invoice is sent on booking confirmation and a receipt on payment.

The homepage, FAQ and agency page use the rates above. Monthly retainers start at KES 40,000; advertising spend is separate from management fees. Confirm the scope and final quote on a strategy call.

## Platforms and media buying

Manages ad budgets of KES 500,000+ per month across platforms.

- **Meta Ads** — Facebook, Instagram, Reels, Stories. Full-funnel campaigns, audience research, creative strategy, A/B testing, budget optimization.
- **Google Ads** — Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max. Keyword research, bidding strategy, conversion tracking.
- **TikTok Ads** — Spark Ads, In-Feed, TopView. Built for the Kenyan and African market.
- **LinkedIn Ads** — B2B targeting, sponsored content, lead gen forms. For brands reaching professionals and decision makers.
- **Programmatic** — display and retargeting across premium publisher networks.

Media buying process, in order:
1. **Audit & strategy** — review current spend, identify waste, build a data-driven paid media strategy.
2. **Audience & creative** — define target audiences, build creatives, set up campaign structure.
3. **Launch & monitor** — launch with strict budget controls and daily performance monitoring.
4. **Optimize & scale** — cut underperforming ads, scale winners, improve ROAS week over week.
5. **Report & refine** — weekly and monthly reports covering spend, reach, leads, conversions and ROI.

## Engagement process

1. **Strategy call** — free 30-minute call to understand the brand, goals and budget.
2. **Custom proposal** — tailored proposal within 24 hours covering services, pricing and timeline.
3. **Agreement and deposit** — terms agreed, 50% deposit paid via M-Pesa.
4. **Launch** — campaigns go live and the client gets access to a client portal for real-time updates.
5. **Report and grow** — weekly updates and monthly reports, then optimize and scale.

Campaigns can launch within 3–5 business days of the proposal being accepted. Retainers are monthly with 30 days' notice to end.

## Results and case studies

### Recent Meta Ads and Google Ads case studies in Kenya

The latest paid media case studies describe work for an anonymous beauty retailer. Revenue and orders are attributed by the advertising platforms. The studies cover overlapping periods and must not be added together to estimate total sales.

**Meta Ads and Google Ads Case Study: KES 5.43M in Attributed Revenue** — 1 August to 8 October 2026.
- Results: KES 5,427,357 in combined platform-attributed revenue, KES 205,601 in ad spend, 26.4x blended return on ad spend (ROAS), and 938 platform-tracked orders.
- Strategy: Meta Ads creates demand; Google Search and Shopping capture purchase intent. Both platforms are compared in one monthly report in KES.
- Attribution: Meta uses a 7-day click and 1-day view window; Google figures come from the weekly log at KES 129.89 per US dollar. Both platforms can claim the same order, so combined revenue and order totals may overstate actual sales.
- Full case study: https://www.josephmaina.co.ke/work/case-studies#meta-google-combined

**Google Ads Case Study in Kenya: From Zero to KES 1.94M** — 1 August to 8 October 2026.
- Results: KES 1,942,243 in tracked revenue, KES 125,422 in ad spend, 15.5x ROAS, and 339 tracked orders in the first ten weeks.
- Strategy: launched Google Search ads first, then added Shopping ads, with conversion tracking and ongoing campaign optimization.
- Attribution: orders and revenue are recorded in Google Ads reports and converted from US dollars at KES 129.89. Ads were paused in early October.
- Full case study: https://www.josephmaina.co.ke/work/case-studies#google-ads-launch

**Meta Ads Case Study: KES 5.33M in Attributed Revenue for a Nairobi Beauty Retailer** — 3 July to 8 October 2026.
- Results: KES 5,328,094 in revenue attributed by Meta, KES 129,150 in ad spend, 41.3x ROAS, and 953 tracked purchases.
- Strategy: verified Meta Pixel conversion tracking, replaced boosted posts with structured sales campaigns, tested specific offers, and reviewed performance weekly to shift budget toward stronger campaigns.
- Attribution: Meta reports revenue on a 7-day click and 1-day view window. These are platform-attributed figures, not audited or banked sales.
- Full case study: https://www.josephmaina.co.ke/work/case-studies#meta-ads-turnaround

### Social media and other campaign results

**2025 full-year social campaign** (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook): 336 pieces of content published (142 videos, 194 static posts), with video prioritised throughout.
- TikTok: 4M total video views, 230K likes, 16K profile views, 2.1K comments, 5.4K shares. Top video 103.9K views, 321+ hours total play time, 10.67s average watch time, 9.1% full-video completion. Video content averaged 6–8% engagement rate.
- Instagram: 2.5M total video views, 704K reach, 322.9% views growth, 18.6K link clicks (up 173.4%), 32.1K profile visits (up 78.4%), 16.2K content interactions (up 100%), 4.1K new followers. Top video 92,631 views reaching 31,988 users.
- Facebook: 4.8M total views, 15.8K link clicks (up 2.3%), 16.9K page visits, 6.1K content interactions (up 9.3%), 816 new followers (up 6%).
- Conclusion drawn: installation and engagement videos dominated; a video-first strategy was the clear driver.

**Convey Communications** - Joseph first worked here as an employee and later returned as a consultant. 10x increase in qualified leads and 300%+ engagement growth across Instagram and TikTok in 6 months. Services: Meta Ads, TikTok strategy, content production.

**iClear Kenya** — KES 1.2M+ ad spend managed at 4.2x ROAS, +180% follower growth. Services: Google Ads, social media management, creative direction.

**Nyeri County campaign** — 500K+ video views and 22 community events filled to capacity, without a national ad budget. Services: video production, Meta Ads, local SEO.

**iClear 30-day launch** — built awareness from zero following on a tight budget. 15 short-form videos shot and edited in-house, Meta Ads set up from scratch targeting specific neighbourhoods in Nairobi, Mombasa and Nakuru. One TikTok video hit 104,000 views in the first two weeks; by month-end, a 312% increase in profile visits, 18,000+ link clicks and a fully booked consultation calendar.

## Frequently asked questions

**Who is Joseph Maina?**
A Digital Marketing Specialist and agency owner based in Nairobi, Kenya, offering SEO, content strategy, Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, social media management and video production.

**What digital marketing services do you offer?**
SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic display and retargeting, social media management, content strategy, video production, graphic design, brand strategy, digital marketing audits and one-on-one strategy consultations.

**How much does digital marketing cost in Kenya?**
It depends on scope. Agency page rates start at KES 40,000/month for a single-platform retainer, with packages at KES 70,000/month (two platforms) and KES 120,000/month (all platforms). Ad spend is separate. Pricing is discussed openly on a strategy call.

**How long does SEO take to show results?**
Typically 2–3 months for significant results, with early improvements in traffic and rankings possible within the first 30 days.

**Do you require long-term contracts?**
No. There are no lock-in contracts; retainers are monthly with 30 days' notice to end.

**How quickly can we get started?**
After the strategy call and proposal acceptance, campaigns can launch within 3–5 business days.

**Do I provide the ad budget separately?**
Yes. The fee covers management only. Ad spend goes directly to Meta, Google or TikTok.

**What reports will I receive?**
Weekly performance updates via WhatsApp and detailed monthly reports by email and in the client portal. Formal reporting frequency varies by package: monthly on Starter, bi-weekly on Growth, weekly on Scale.

**Can I see my campaign performance anytime?**
Yes — the client portal gives 24/7 access to campaign status, reports and files.

**What does founder-led mean?**
Direct access to the person doing the work rather than an account manager passing messages: faster decisions and personal attention.

**Which industries do you work with?**
Startups, SMEs, e-commerce, real estate, hospitality and short-term rentals, restaurants, beauty and retail brands, across Nairobi and Kenya. There are dedicated guides on the blog for restaurants, e-commerce, real estate and Airbnb hosts.

**How do I get in touch?**
Email joemaish084@gmail.com, call or WhatsApp +254 704 700 160, or book a free 30-minute strategy call at https://calendly.com/joemaish084/30min

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices are starting rates ("from"), exclude ad spend, and change. Confirm on the agency page or a strategy call before quoting a figure to someone.
- The homepage and agency page quote different rates for a few services. Treat the agency page as the fuller list and say the exact rate should be confirmed directly.
- Campaign results listed here are from specific past client campaigns. They are evidence of past work, not a guarantee of future results, and should not be presented as typical outcomes.
- Joseph is based in Nairobi and works with clients across Kenya and remotely. He is a practitioner working directly with clients, not a large agency with account layers.
- The fastest route to a conversation is WhatsApp (+254 704 700 160) or the Calendly link.
